findings.summary: Prior REVISE blocker H1 is resolved at source level on the exact candidate: durable owner/request/digest-scoped recording claim (usp_ClaimResumeIntakeRecordingForOwner plus in-memory/SQL adapters) is acquired before provider contact; only the lease holder transcribes; contenders receive honest pending/conflict/completed-replay outcomes; finalization binds the same claim, source, digest, policy and lifecycle versions; stale workers and purge/revocation are fenced; an expired lease records recovery_required and never transfers provider custody.

The exact candidate passed 213 focused checks plus 23 subtests and 16 Chrome-to-Flask browser journeys with no blocking findings. Changed files stay within the 38 claimed Package C surfaces. Two non-blocking advisories (in-memory test-clock skew note, unit-of-work claim-restore note) require no change.

Evidence is synthetic, in-memory, and simulator-backed SQL-contract only. Two-connection SQL-engine execution, live transcription providers, production, schema application, enablement, live identity, D-G backends, and full My Data UI remain withheld and outside this package.
